title.en: An Act Extending the Franchises of the Bicol Electric Company, Inc. for Another Twenty-Five Years
title.orig: An Act Extending the Franchises of the Bicol Electric Company, Inc. for Another Twenty-Five Years

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5359_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established under Act Numbered Twenty-six hundred and forty-seven, as amended by Act Numbered Twenty-eight hundred and eighty-two, the franchise granted to Mariano Abella Y Isaac, and assumed and taken by the Bicol Electric Company, to install, operate and maintain an electric light, heat and power system in the City of Naga; and of the franchises granted by resolutions of the municipal councils of Camaligan, Bombon and Calabanga in the Province of Camarines Sur; of the municipal councils of Ligao, Oas and Guinobatan in the Province of Albay; and of the municipal council of Gubat in the Province of Sorsogon, to the Manila Electric Company, assumed and taken over by the Bicol Electric Company, to install, operate and maintain an electric light, heat and power system in their respective municipalities, later revised and consolidated by Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and thirty-four, are hereby extended for a period of twenty-five years from the date of their expiration.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
